Drive Modes The standard Driver Mode Selector allows you to choose from Tour, Sport, Track and Weather modes as well as the customizable MyMode. You can also activate the customizable Z Mode by pressing a button on the steering wheel. The modes affect throttle response, suspension and overall handling for a truly tailored drive. Tour Mode Provides a balanced blend of comfort and performance, ideal for regular city and highway journeys. Sport Mode Enhances responsiveness and power for sporty environments, with firmer suspension and more aggressive throttle and steering feel. Track Mode Prioritizes performance on closed courses or tracks, allowing for maximum control and speed. Weather Mode Optimizes the car’s performance for slippery conditions like rain or snow by adjusting throttle response, transmission shifts, and traction control.
